description: Updates a member's role/type (admin, normal, or observer) in a Trello organization. Note: This operation requires a premium Trello workspace - free workspaces cannot change memberships.

idMember.description: The 24-character hex ID of the member whose role in the organization should be updated.
idMember.title: Id Member

idOrg.description: The ID or name of the Trello organization (workspace). Can be the 24-character hex ID or the organization's short name.
idOrg.title: Id Org

type.description: The new membership type/role for the member in this organization. Determines permissions: 'admin' has full control, 'normal' is a standard member, 'observer' has read-only access. Note: Requires a premium workspace to change membership types.
type.title: Type
